metadata.database: A Deeper China | Jingmai decision layer

JMM01.guest_need: A visitor wants Jingmai understood as a living tea-forest cultural landscape.
JMM01.hidden_need: Replace old-tree tea marketing with one ecological and community question.
JMM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A landscape system is deeper than a tea-shopping circuit or village checklist.
JMM01.stop_condition: The visitor can connect forest, tea cultivation, villages and livelihoods.
JMM01.low_energy_branch: Use one public landscape interpretation layer.
JMM01.rain_branch: Use confirmed indoor/contextual material and remove exposed trail claims.

JMM02.guest_need: A visitor needs enough protected nights for remote roads, weather and recovery.
JMM02.hidden_need: Prevent a remote landscape from becoming a rushed transfer.
JMM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A pacing decision protects the landscape question and a weather buffer.
JMM02.stop_condition: Transfer, base, recovery and departure constraints are explicit.
JMM02.low_energy_branch: Keep one base and remove village/road extensions.
JMM02.rain_branch: Use current road and accommodation information before moving.
JMM02.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high transfer sensitivity.

JMM03.guest_need: A visitor wants to observe village life without treating residents as attractions.
JMM03.hidden_need: Replace an 'authentic encounter' request with consent-led public observation.
JMM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: Consent and public boundaries protect the community better than naming a private home or farm.
JMM03.stop_condition: The visitor understands what can be observed and what cannot be requested.
JMM03.low_energy_branch: Use public space only; no interaction assumption.
JMM03.rain_branch: Remove village/field exposure and keep a public indoor layer.
JMM03.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking, high consent and language sensitivity.

JMM04.guest_need: A visitor needs to distinguish learning, tasting, buying, collecting and health/investment claims.
JMM04.hidden_need: Prevent tea curiosity from becoming authentication or financial advice.
JMM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A due-diligence method is more valuable than another shop or tasting list.
JMM04.stop_condition: The visitor knows what remains independently verifiable.
JMM04.low_energy_branch: Use one public tasting/learning framework without seller endorsement.
JMM04.rain_branch: Use a confirmed public indoor context.
JMM04.body_cost: Low walking, high provenance and commercial sensitivity.

JMM05.guest_need: A visitor needs walking, weather and ecological behaviour matched to the mountain.
JMM05.hidden_need: Turn scenic ambition into low-impact, reversible movement.
JMM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A terrain and ecology method protects the trip better than a photo route.
JMM05.stop_condition: The visitor knows the route, surface, weather and behaviour limits.
JMM05.low_energy_branch: Use the shortest permitted public path and stop early.
JMM05.rain_branch: Remove muddy, exposed or uncertain routes.
JMM05.body_cost: Potentially high mud, road, heat and visibility load.

JMM06.guest_need: A visitor needs a viable base, food, connectivity and recovery plan.
JMM06.hidden_need: Avoid romantic remote-stay recommendations that ignore practical fragility.
JMM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A recovery audit affects safety and enjoyment more than another viewpoint.
JMM06.stop_condition: Arrival, sleep, food, power, connectivity and fallback are acceptable.
JMM06.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high operational sensitivity.

JMM07.guest_need: A visitor wants an interaction only when consent, safety and community benefit are evidenced.
JMM07.hidden_need: Prevent tea-maker, guide or driver resources from becoming invented inventory.
JMM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A release gate protects people and the guest better than a list of 'authentic' contacts.
JMM07.stop_condition: Consent, language, fee, capacity, access, photos, safety and release status are explicit.
JMM07.low_energy_branch: Use public observation with no interaction promise.
JMM07.rain_branch: Only a confirmed indoor partner programme may be considered.
JMM07.body_cost: Variable social, road and safety load.

JMM08.guest_need: A visitor needs a clear stop condition when weather, roads, health or evidence fail.
JMM08.hidden_need: Make uncertainty visible instead of generating confident substitutes.
JMM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A release gate protects the traveller and community better than more content.
JMM08.stop_condition: Dated evidence, unresolved risks and a fallback are recorded.
JMM08.low_energy_branch: Pause and retain only the safest public layer.
JMM08.rain_branch: Stop if road, access or safety evidence is missing.
JMM08.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high liability sensitivity.
